description: List subscriptions and resources; query actual Azure costs

io.github.personaljarvis.post_install_hint_md: Create your own Microsoft Entra public/native application with redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:43891/oauth/callback, then enter its client ID in this dialog. Enable personal and work/school accounts when supported; no client secret is needed for a public app. Grant only the delegated permissions listed below. Tenant policies may require administrator consent. Each plugin is connected separately and shares only your app registration. Azure requires a work/school account, Azure Service Management delegated permission and Cost Management Reader or equivalent for billing.
